title: The Last Card Standing
statement:
A deck has `n` cards numbered `1` to `n`, with card `1` on top and card `n` at the bottom. Repeat this until one card is left: throw away the top card, then move the new top card to the bottom of the deck. Which card is left at the end?

## Input
One line containing `n`.

## Output
Print the number of the last remaining card.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 10^18`
